nameJa: 映像を広く見せる輪郭
conceptNote: 細い輪郭と控えめな再生記号で、広い映像にチャットを重ねる。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE sophisticated text-free Chrome Web Store discovery tile, landscape 11:7 aspect ratio (target1760x1120), not panoramic. Art direction: refined Swiss digital editorial, restrained proportions, exact alignment, nuanced negative space, crisp flat UI illustration. Communicate instantly: live chat floats OVER video that fills the fullscreen boundary. ONE video surface with four short fine fullscreen L-brackets at its FOUR OUTERMOST corners; right brackets OUTSIDE and beyond chat. Chat is inset on all four sides, about26% video width and60–68%videoheight; video visibly continues BEHIND its translucent panel. Native chat rhythm: five small round avatars with fine horizontal geometric message strokes of varied lengths, airy row spacing, a slender outlined composer and small send arrow at bottom. The strokes are shapes, never text. Play triangle should be small and elegant, not a huge central button; a fine video progress line near bottom helps establish video. No chat outside fullscreen boundary, no separate sidebar seam. Avoid chunky icons, oversize round corners, bulky card shadows, plastic/clay3D, fake monitor, isometric views, neon glow, ornamental stars, landscape/scenery/people, UI chrome, extra windows. No words, no letters, no numbers, no pseudo-text, no logo or watermark anywhere. The image itself has zero typography. No captions. Keep all essential elements readable at440x280 and220x140.
Direction 08: Very pale cool-grey artboard. Large ink-black fullscreen video rectangle with subtly rounded3px-equivalent corners, short delicate light-grey outer fullscreen marks. A nearly borderless light translucent chat at right, lower contrast but readable, with small charcoal message lines and muted warmgrey avatars, one coral accent. Single broad flat slate-grey diagonal shape behind chat. Tiny white outlined play triangle left. One thin continuous coral video progress rule extends below chat to far right, clearly single video underneath.

revisions.prompt: Edit target: the provided promotional diagram. Change ONLY the video player controls. Remove the play triangle floating around the left-middle/center of the video and restore the uninterrupted underlying video there. At the BOTTOM-LEFT of the video add one tiny white play triangle in a subtle dark control strip, followed by a small white speaker/volume icon and a small solid red live-status dot (dot only). Put the thin progress line directly ABOVE that controls strip. Tiny fullscreen control at far bottom-right. Like the actual YouTube fullscreen livestream player composition, WITHOUT any text or timestamps. Keep original 11:7 canvas dimensions, ALL background geometric forms, colors, translucent chat, chat avatar/message strokes, composer/send arrow, outer fullscreen corners, outer margins and positions unchanged. Chat is above controls. NO central/left-middle play symbol. No letters, numbers, labels or watermark. Preserve all shapes and chat from original except rearranged video playback controls.
